explication: Pyright is a high-performance static type checker for Python, delivered as a command-line tool and a Visual Studio Code extension. The principal workflow is a user submitting a workspace for analysis, followed by parsing, type evaluation, and diagnostics. The repository also contains editor language-service features, command handling, and a separate type-server/notebook surface. Edges are limited to relationships documented in the README or visible in the supplied source index; where implementation details were not sampled, uncertain links are omitted.
